correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the cycle excess exactly to a centered trace using leaf elimination of forests, computes all spherical cap eigenvalues via Funk–Hecke and normalized Gegenbauer Sturm–Liouville, controls all higher eigenvalues by an exact complex-moment bound, and uses Hilbert–Schmidt Parseval and gamma-ratio asymptotics. Numerical independent integrations and simulations corroborate the argument; no finite computation is used as proof.

value.rationale: A single explicit spectral bracket controls the entire finite-dimensional cyclic spherical cap probability excess, and it yields an all-even-cycle sharp coefficient at every fixed probability. This is a motivated quantitative refinement of previously known graph Fourier order bounds; the previously known sign and harmonic ingredients alone are not counted as the contribution.
